entities.summary: Jean Grondin is a Canadian philosopher and professor, born in Cap-de-la-Madeleine. He is a specialist in the thought of Immanuel Kant, Hans-Georg Gadamer, and Martin Heidegger. His research focuses on hermeneutics, phenomenology, German classical philosophy, and the history of metaphysics.
